title: Use typed ACP completion command for missing-authority launch diagnostics
outcome: A missing-authority ACP full-gate completion with no rawInput.command reports its actual missing authority instead of falsely claiming that its command changed, while retaining the original unmatched window.
acceptance: Diagnostic completion distinguishes absent actual command from display title and from an explicit changed or unrecognized command.
Tests cover missing actual ACP command, explicit matching/changed command, disabled and foreign observations, original root/start retention and qualified-pipe refusal.
